title: Disk Tools and Menu
description: The Games Diskette menu and small utilities from the recovered disks.
versionOrder: Disk saves have no recorded order or dates beyond their source comments. Any ordering here is a presentation guess.

versions.label: HELP.BAS (BASIC Programs Games)
versions.note: The Games Diskette’s menu: BASIC GAMES DISKETTE ONE.
versions.unavailableReason: Preserved as source. It is not offered as a player.
versions.startupSource:
5 DIM C$(11)
10 CLS
20 PRINT"
                BASIC GAMES DISKETTE ONE
"
40 C=0
50 C=C+1:READ N$,C$(C),D$
55 IF N$="DONE"THEN 300
60 PRINT CHR$(C+ASC("A")-1)") "N$" - "D$
70 IF C<10 THEN 50
80 PRINT"
SELECT A LETTER  OR  PRESS ENTER FOR MORE CHOICES ";

versions.label: GETDISK.BAS (Talker)
versions.unavailableReason: Preserved as source. It is not offered as a player.
versions.startupSource:
10 '            GETDISK
20 '            -------
30 'PROGRAM TO COPY DISK FILES TO CASSETTE
40 '
50 CLEAR 1000
60 DEFSTR D-F: DEFINT I: DIM D(4)
70 CLS
80 FV=""
90 FOR I=24003 TO 24005: FV=FV+CHR$(PEEK(I)):NEXT
100 IF FV="1.1" THEN IV=26228 ELSE IV=0
110 PRINT@6*64,"THIS PROGRAM COPIES A DISK FILE TO CASSETTE."
120 LINEINPUT"WHAT IS THE NAME OF THE DISK FILE? ";F

versions.label: DISKDUMP.BAS (Talker)
versions.note: SECTOR DUMP UTILITY 2.2: prints a file’s sectors in hex and text.
versions.unavailableReason: Preserved as source. It is not offered as a player.
versions.startupSource:
100 CLEAR2000:CLS:PRINT:PRINTTAB(15)"SECTOR DUMP UTILITY 2.2":DEFINTI-N
110 H$="0123456789ABCDEF"
120 LINEINPUT"
FILESPEC: ";FS$:IFFS$="END"THENEND ELSE ONERRORGOTO290:OPEN"I",1,FS$
130 ONERRORGOTO0:CLOSE:OPEN"R",1,FS$:SN=0
140 FIELD1,255 AS D$,1 AS DD$
150 LINEINPUT"
SECTOR NUMBER (OR 'ENTER' FOR NEXT SECTOR): ";S$
160 IFPEEK(14312)>127THENPRINT"LP NOT READY":GOTO150
170 IFS$=""THENSN=SN+1ELSESN=VAL(S$):IFSN<1THENCLOSE:GOTO100
180 GET1,SN
190 LPRINT" ":LPRINT"FILESPEC: "FS$;TAB(35)"SECTOR: "SN:LPRINT" "

versions.label: CASEFIX.BAS (Talker)
versions.note: Converts a text file’s lowercase to uppercase. Has a bug at line 60.
versions.unavailableReason: Preserved as source. It is not offered as a player.
versions.startupSource:
10 CLS:CLEAR20000:DIM R$(500):R=0
20 INPUT "FILE";F$
30 OPEN "I",1,F$
40 IF EOF(1) THEN 100 ELSE R=R+1:LINE INPUT #1,R$(R):GOTO40
50 PRINT "CONVERTING"
60 FOR I=1TOR:FORL=1TOR$(I):L$=MID$(R$(I),L,1):IF L$>="a" AND L$<="z" THEN MID$(R$(I),L,1)=CHR$(ASC(L$)-32)
70 NEXT L,I
80 CLOSE:OPEN"O",1,F$
90 FORI=1TOR:PRINT#1,R$(I):NEXTI:CLOSE
